packageRules.description: Action bumps are low risk and this repo's releases depend on them staying current.
gradle/actions v6 moved caching into a proprietary component whose Terms of Use you accept by upgrading. Held at v5 (MIT) until the owner decides.
CI's JDK stays on 17 until it is moved deliberately. Gradle 9 would run on newer, but the build, CLAUDE.md and README all say 17, so a bump is its own change (docs/TODO.md).
The -compat builds are a migration aid for libraries stuck on the 0.6 API, not a release to adopt.
Compose ships as a fleet; updating it piecemeal produces version skew.
AGP and Kotlin move together with the Compose compiler plugin. AGP 9 compiles Kotlin itself, so the app applies no kotlin-android plugin; the compose plugin carries the Kotlin version.
Patch bumps automerge. Minor and major wait for a look, though they are built by CI too.
